default.sql: WITH cur AS ( SELECT entity_slug, dimension, value, source_markdown_slug AS source, confidence, id AS fact_id FROM facts WHERE dimension IS NOT NULL AND expired_at IS NULL AND valid_until IS NULL AND (dim_status IS NULL OR dim_status = 'active') AND confidence >= $1 AND ($2::text IS NULL OR source_id = $3) ) SELECT entity_slug, dimension, json_agg(json_build_object('value', value, 'source', source, 'confidence', confidence, 'fact_id', fact_id)) AS values FROM cur GROUP BY entity_slug, dimension HAVING count(DISTINCT value) >= 2 AND count(DISTINCT source) >= 2 ORDER BY entity_slug, dimension

sourceIds+excludePrivate.sql: WITH cur AS ( SELECT entity_slug, dimension, value, source_markdown_slug AS source, confidence, id AS fact_id FROM facts WHERE dimension IS NOT NULL AND expired_at IS NULL AND valid_until IS NULL AND (dim_status IS NULL OR dim_status = 'active') AND confidence >= $1 AND source_id = ANY($2) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pages pp WHERE pp.source_id = facts.source_id AND pp.slug = facts.source_markdown_slug AND NOT ((COALESCE(pp.frontmatter->>'visibility', CASE WHEN (pp.type = 'atom' OR (pp.type = 'concept' AND pp.frontmatter->>'synthesized_by' IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'private' ELSE 'world' END) <> 'private' AND NOT (CASE WHEN pp.type = 'atom' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pages derived_origin WHERE derived_origin.source_id = pp.source_id AND derived_origin.slug = pp.frontmatter->>'source_slug' AND derived_origin.frontmatter->>'visibility' = 'private') WHEN (pp.type = 'atom' OR (pp.type = 'concept' AND pp.frontmatter->>'synthesized_by' IS NOT NULL)) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM links derived_input_link JOIN pages derived_input ON derived_input.id = derived_input_link.to_page_id WHERE derived_input_link.from_page_id = pp.id AND derived_input_link.link_source = 'concept-provenance' AND derived_input_link.link_type = 'synthesized_from' AND (COALESCE(derived_input.frontmatter->>'visibility', CASE WHEN derived_input.type = 'atom' THEN 'private' ELSE 'world' END) = 'private' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pages derived_input_origin WHERE derived_input_origin.source_id = derived_input.source_id AND derived_input_origin.slug = derived_input.frontmatter->>'source_slug' AND derived_input_origin.frontmatter->>'visibility' = 'private'))) ELSE false END)))) ) SELECT entity_slug, dimension, json_agg(json_build_object('value', value, 'source', source, 'confidence', confidence, 'fact_id', fact_id)) AS values FROM cur GROUP BY entity_slug, dimension HAVING count(DISTINCT value) >= 2 AND count(DISTINCT source) >= 2 ORDER BY entity_slug, dimension

SELECT DISTINCT ON (dimension) dimension, value, confidence, source_markdown_slug AS source, valid_from, valid_until AS valid_to, COALESCE(dim_status, 'active') AS status, id AS fact_id FROM facts WHERE entity_slug = $1 AND dimension IS NOT NULL AND expired_at IS NULL AND ($2::text IS NULL OR source_id = $3) AND COALESCE(valid_from, '-infinity'::timestamptz) <= COALESCE($4::timestamptz, now()) AND COALESCE(valid_until, 'infinity'::timestamptz) > COALESCE($5::timestamptz, now()) AND confidence >= $6 AND ($7::boolean OR dim_status IS NULL OR dim_status = 'active') ORDER BY dimension, valid_from DESC NULLS LAST, confidence DESC, id DESC
